AllowHayBedsComment: If set to false, hay beds cannot be used to set a player's spawn (regardless of the type of amulet being worn).
AllowRustyGearAmuletsComment: If set to false, rusty gear amulets cannot be used to set a player's spawn (only temporal gear amulets can be used).
AmuletsCanBreakAfterRespawnComment: If set to true, amulets will have a chance to break when a player respawns upon death.
BreakingBedRemovesSpawnPointComment: If set to false, when a player breaks the bed, the spawn point will not be removed.
RustyGearAmuletBreakChancePctComment: The chance (%) that a rusty gear amulet will break when a player respawns upon death.
TemporalGearAmuletBreakChancePctComment: The chance (%) that a temporal gear amulet will break when a player respawns upon death.
